C-FIX-011-UNTITLED-CLOSE-ACTIONS.IntentSummary: Land the owner-approved three-action untitled close model: a promise-based DOM dialog (default Save & Close, separate Discard, visible Cancel with Escape/glyph equivalence) replacing the two-discard ElMessageBox; the store's untitled Save & Close runs Save As for the closing tab and closes only on success; component, store and browser coverage pin every path; FIX-007 dark-theme assertions continue on the new surface.
C-FIX-011-UNTITLED-CLOSE-ACTIONS.ExecutionPolicy: Execute sequentially after C-FIX-008-VIEWER-PAN-CUES. Durable scope M-011/V-M-011 is shared with the renderer family; this bundle does not touch muya or the table surface.

Corner.Name: Correctness — three actions, three results
Corner.Expected: The dialog resolves exactly one of save/discard/cancel; every exit (three buttons, Escape, close glyph, backdrop) funnels through the idempotent finish; Enter on the default focuses Save & Close so nothing defaults to discard; nothing is labeled "Close".

Corner.Name: Correctness — untitled save flow
Corner.Expected: Save & Close invokes mt_response_file_save_as with the closing tab's own id/filename/markdown (not currentFile), applies the outcome with the revision guard, and closes only on truthy outcome; cancelled (null) and thrown failures leave the tab and content intact, failures keep the notice.

Corner.Name: Correctness — named regression boundary
Corner.Expected: Named Save & Close still sends the mt::save-and-close-tabs payload with deep-cloned options; explicit Discard closes directly; Cancel keeps the tab.

Corner.Name: Correctness — coverage honesty
Corner.Expected: Component tests assert labels, results, focus and classes; store tests assert the transports and tab fate per action; e2e drives the real store funnel through all seven untitled flows plus the named pair — no case passes vacuously.

Corner.Name: Security and Privacy
Corner.Expected: The dialog renders user-controlled filenames via textContent (no innerHTML on data); synthetic fixtures only; no secrets; no owner data in committed artifacts.

Corner.Name: UX
Corner.Expected: macOS action order (Discard, Cancel, Save & Close) keeps the destructive action away from the default; focus-visible outlines; aria-modal dialog with labelled title and an aria-labelled cancel glyph; the untitled message announces that Save & Close will ask where to save.

Corner.Name: UX — theme continuity
Corner.Expected: The FIX-007 dark-theme regression continues against the new surface with computed colours (float background, editor title, theme-accent default, delete-colour destructive) — ported, not dropped.

Corner.Name: Performance and Footprint
Corner.Expected: A plain DOM dialog with one CSS file; no new dependency (Element Plus stays for other surfaces); focus trap is a four-element array; no build-size-sensitive additions.

Corner.Name: Scope hygiene
Corner.Expected: LISTEN_FOR_CLOSE (window-close batch) is explicitly untouched and recorded as a follow-up candidate with its owner-decision reason; muya and the table surface are untouched.

Corner.Name: Delivery discipline
Corner.Expected: The bundle repairs and verifies; queueing waits for the owner's focused acceptance on the fresh isolated artifact (EP-02 exit gate); no version, tag or publication.
